{{Quote|Her friends won't be able to find her here!|The unidentified Dulok to Umwak|<ref name="TTL" />}}
'''One''' member of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh's]] [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] once helped [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Umwak]] capture the young [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] named [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] when she ventured on their territory. The two Duloks ambushed Latara, starting an avalanche that trapped her within a cave. Once their mischief was accomplished, the two returned to their [[Dulok Swamp|village]] to ask their king what he intended to do with her.<ref name="TTL" />
